title: Resume a finished monitor in Companion
description: Use a finished notify-only monitor and its actual account. Set RESUME_MONITOR_ID and private RESUME_STATE_FILE; detail cards initially collapsed.

open.cmd: if [ "$PLATFORM" = ios ]; then xcrun simctl openurl "$IOS_SIMULATOR" "farmslot-development:///pr-automation?monitorId=$RESUME_MONITOR_ID"; else adb -s "$ANDROID_SERIAL" shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "farmslot-development:///pr-automation?monitorId=$RESUME_MONITOR_ID" net.siteed.farmslot.development; fi
open.intent: A monitor link preserves access to finished subscription history.

ready.intent: The historical monitor remains visible after the provider confirmed completion.

visible.intent: The lifecycle action is reachable below the monitor details.

evidence.intent: The screenshot records the finished monitor and its enabled resume control.

acknowledge.intent: The operator explicitly resumes the same finished subscription without creating another monitor.

verify.intent: The live gateway confirms a new observation generation without starting repair.

before.intent: Record the finished subscription and observation generation before the operator resumes it.

expand.intent: The operator opens actions without rendering every monitor’s full history.
